name: Exp_ColorLeManTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorLeManTrend indicator, which uses three moving averages (Min/Mid/Max) smoothed by an EMA to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator's up-line crosses above the down-line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, while providing configurable permissions for entry and exit. Positions are managed with fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit levels in points.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorLeManTrend指标进行交易，该指标使用三组移动平均线（最小/中间/最大）经EMA平滑后判断趋势方向。当指标上线穿越下线时开多仓，反之开空仓，同时提供可配置的入场和出场权限。仓位使用固定的点数止损和止盈进行管理。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于ColorLeManTrend指标的趋势跟踪系统，核心概念是利用三组不同周期（13/21/34）的移动平均线经EMA（周期3）平滑后的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当UpValue[1]>DnValue[1]且前一根K线UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0]时产生买入信号，即上线从下方穿越下线；反之当上线从上方穿越下线时产生卖出信号。出场条件由两个部分组成：一是趋势反转时自动平仓（多头在卖出信号出现时平仓，空头在买入信号出现时平仓），二是使用固定的止损1000点和止盈2000点进行风险管理。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，当MM为负值时直接作为手数使用，当MM为正值时作为资金比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种方式，但缺乏加仓、减仓等动态仓位调整机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is a trend-following system based on the ColorLeManTrend indicator, whose core concept uses crossovers of three moving average groups (periods 13/21/34) smoothed by an EMA (period 3) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] and the previous bar's UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0], meaning the up-line has just crossed above the down-line; conversely, a sell signal occurs when the up-line crosses below the down-line. Exit conditions consist of two parts: automatic closing on trend reversal (long positions close when a sell signal appears, short positions close when a buy signal appears), and fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for risk management. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter: negative values are used directly as lot size, while positive values represent a share of the deposit to calculate lot size. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting both deposit-proportion and fixed-lot approaches, but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms such as scaling in or out.

parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于均线交叉的趋势跟踪方法经过长期验证
提供完整的入场和出场权限控制，可灵活配置多空方向
使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免同根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数明确，风险可控
支持按存款比例动态计算手数，便于资金管理
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on moving average crossover, a well-validated trend-following approach
Comprehensive entry and exit permission controls, allowing flexible long/short direction configuration
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents repeated entries within the same bar
Explicit stop loss and take profit parameters provide defined risk control
Supports deposit-proportion dynamic lot sizing for better money management
cons: 仅依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制，容易产生假信号
没有交易时间过滤、点差过滤和市场条件检查，在剧烈波动或高点差时可能不利
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未考虑ATR等动态波动率调整
缺少最大持仓数限制和连续亏损保护机制
MM参数为负值表示手数的设计容易造成用户混淆和误操作
cons_en: Relies solely on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation or filtering, prone to false signals
No trading session filter, spread filter, or market condition check, which may be disadvantageous during high volatility or wide spreads
Fixed stop loss (1000 pts) and take profit (2000 pts) without ATR-based dynamic adjustment
Lacks maximum position limit and consecutive loss protection mechanisms
Negative MM value meaning lot size is counterintuitive and error-prone for users
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈和波动率过滤机制，避免在低波动或极端波动行情中交易
增加点差过滤、交易时段限制和最大连续亏损保护，提高策略的鲁棒性
增加多时间周期确认或多指标过滤（如RSI、ADX）以减少假信号
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and volatility filtering to avoid trading in low or extreme volatility conditions
Add spread filter, trading session restrictions, and maximum consecutive loss protection to improve strategy robustness
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicator filters (e.g., RSI, ADX) to reduce false signals

risk_points: 单一指标信号无多维度确认，在震荡行情中可能频繁虚假开仓导致连续亏损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动市场止损可能过小导致频繁止损
缺少最大持仓限制和资金回撤保护，极端行情下可能造成重大损失
risk_points_en: Single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation may cause frequent false entries and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss/take profit without volatility adaptation may result in frequent stops during high volatility periods
No maximum position limit or drawdown protection, which could lead to significant losses during extreme market conditions
